notes.title: 2025.9.25 Update: Submodel feature and Model Slot Editing
notes.notes: [h3][b]Version：2025.9.25[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Json Config: [/b]Added "add_submodel" and "remove_submodel" commands[/p][/*][*][p][b]Json Config: [/b]Renamed "change_cos" command to "change_model"[/p][/*][*][p][b]EX Studio: [/b]Merged Live2D/Spine editor and uploader[/p][/*][*][p][b]EX Studio: [/b]User interface optimization[/p][/*][*][p][b]Common: [/b]Added submodel feature[/p][/*][*][p][b]Common: [/b]Added model slot editing feature[/p][/*][*][p][b]Common: [/b]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]About Model Slot Editing[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Mainly used to configure the default position, size, etc. of models when they are loaded into a specific slot. When a model is loaded for the first time, it will use this slot setting.[/p][p][/p][p]In the Control Panel or Quick Menu, click Edit Model Slot to open the editing panel, where you can configure the default position, size, and other settings of a model slot. You can switch model slots using the menu in the upper-left corner. Drag the crosshair intersection or adjust the X/Y values in the panel to set the default position. The Reset All Model Transforms button resets all models’ position, size, and related settings for the current model slot.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Use case:[/b][/p][p]If a user wants all models to be placed in the corner of the screen without editing each one individually, they can move the model slot to the corner and click the 'Reset all model transforms' button. After that, all models loaded for the first time will default to this position.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29049399/07b68a4dec7a17c62f38eb1195185deba3f2099a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]About Merging Live2D and Spine Editors[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]After the merge, you can freely switch between Live2D and Spine models, including switching via the change_model command. Submodels of different types can also be displayed simultaneously.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]About Submodels[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Use cases[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some models separate the background and character. You can set the character as the parent model and load the background on startup, allowing both models to move and scale as a single unit.[/p][/*][*][p]When creating models, you can separate UI, character, and background to reduce complexity of a single model. This also enables dynamic switching of backgrounds or characters, offering greater flexibility than simply replacing textures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Limitations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Submodels can only be added or removed by the parent model through commands. Submodels cannot have their own submodels. When the parent model is removed, its submodels are removed as well.[/p][/*][*][p]When adding a submodel, you can set its display order from -3 to 3. The parent model is at position 0, positive values display in front, negative values display behind. Multiple models can occupy the same position, but overlapping may cause display issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Users cannot adjust the position or size of submodels; only initial position and size can be set in the Json configuration. Submodels will follow the parent model’s movement and scaling.[/p][/*][*][p]Since there is no dedicated editing panel for submodels, you cannot change expressions or adjust mesh opacity from the editor; these can only be changed via commands.[/p][/*][*][p]Submodels use the parent model’s text box for text display, so if multiple models display text at the same time, they may compete for the same text box.[/p][/*][*][p]When using Workshop items or WPK files, submodels share the parent model’s save data, meaning changes to floating-point variables, affinity, etc., affect both. With LPK or Json files, the submodel’s save data is separate from the parent model.[/p][/*][*][p]Submodels and parent models can be different types (e.g., parent is Live2D, submodel is Spine).[/p][/*][*][p]To ensure performance and prevent abuse, a maximum of 6 submodels can be added.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]How to use[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Add submodel:[/b] add_submodel config.json 1 (1 is the position, an integer in the range -3 to 3. The parent model is at position 0; values greater than 0 display in front, values less than 0 display behind.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Remove submodel:[/b] remove_submodel config.json (removes all submodels with the configuration name config.json)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29049399/8852ca3b9e0eba9d3f8bb4d4db73f1cf725f0f16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

[h3][b]About the breaking change to model position and size[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Reason for the change:[/b][/p][p]To simplify the setup of model position and size, and to prepare for an upcoming major feature update.[/p][p][b]Before the change:[/b][/p][p]Both the model slot adjustments and individual model adjustments were applied. When loading another model, it would inherit the current model slot settings plus its own saved settings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]After the change:[/b][/p][p]Model slot adjustments have been removed. Each model’s position, size, and related settings are now saved completely independently. The editing panel will only edit each model individually. Models are saved separately based on the model slot number and the screen aspect ratio.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Impact on existing users:[/b][/p][olist][*][p]On the first launch after the update: The settings of loaded models will be overwritten by the model slot settings, which may cause changes to model position or size.[/p][/*][*][p]On the second and subsequent launches: Models will be displayed only according to their individually saved settings.[/p][/*][*][p]For old scene snapshots: If a model was individually adjusted, its position or size may change. If it was not individually adjusted, there will be no effect.[/p][/*][/olist]

The program will automatically add a backslash [\] before a space in the name as an identifier of the space, and remove the backslash when executing the command.
Please note that the program can only automatically add a backslash to the name selected from the selection panel. You need to add a backslash before the space in the name if you write the command manually.

For example: 
change_cos my model.model3.json
-->
change_cos my\ model.model3.json
[/list]

notes.title: EX Face Tracker (iOS) Now Available
notes.notes:
This app is an extended application of Live2DViewerEX, which can capture facial information through an iOS device and transfer data to Live2DViewerEX for PC via network.

■ Features:

- Remote control: supports up to 8 devices controlling 8 models
- Face tracking powered by ARKit
- 20 controllable parameters

■ Note:

- Requires iOS device that supports Face ID
- Requires iOS device and computer to be in the same LAN
- Requires to set 'Listen Address' to 'Any' in tray setting (PC)
- If you cannot connect, please check whether it is blocked by the firewall

-------------------------------------------

This app makes use of automatically collected information using the device camera and the TrueDepth API provided by Apple. The only use of this information is to track the user’s head and face so that the user can control characters by moving their head. None of the information collected by the TrueDepth API ever leaves the user's device nor is it persistently stored on the device. We do not share information with third parties, do not store or process in any other way the data which we accessed and used via TrueDepth API

notes.title: About illegal Live2D content in Workshop
notes.notes:
A few days ago, I received a warning from Live2D Inc. that the software that uses Live2D SDK cannot infringe third-party rights, according to the agreement with Live2D Inc.

Therefore, I would like to appeal to everyone not to upload [u][b]Live2D content extracted from other software or games[/b][/u] to Workshop. [b][i](Live2D works (Doujin) by yourself are not included)[/i][/b]

If you have previously uploaded, I hope you can set visibility to friends only or just yourself. (Deleting an item will cause the subscribed users to lose the model)

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

[b]About Workshop, I would like to say a few more words:[/b]

Live2DViewerEX has been in development for two years since its release. The software is constantly improving, but Workshop has not made much progress. The main reason is that making Live2D models is so difficult, there are very few people who are willing to make free sharing. Even for Facerig, the number of Live2D models in Workshop is only over 400.

As for the situation of Workshop, I am also very embarrassed. I have no ability to find a breakthrough. I am deeply sorry for this. I am very sorry.

The goal of Live2DViewerEX is still to be the best Live2D desktop viewer. I still believe that as the software continues to improve, more and more creators will use EX and share their works.

Thank you for all users again.

notes.title: Somthing about GPU usage

Some people said that GPU usage is too high or even up to 50%, but some people said that the usage is low. Why is there such a big different?

[h1][b]GPU usage depends on the current GPU clock frequency. When you find that GPU usage is high, you should check current GPU clock frequency[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Introduction of ExAPI
notes.notes:
[h1][b]About ExAPI[/b][/h1]

ExAPI is WebSocket APIs for Live2DViewerEX. 
With ExAPI you can control many contents of Live2DViewerEX such as model, background, effect, text bubble...


[h1][b]Use Case[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]When you get a new mail or message, you can push notification to Live2DViewerEX instead of system notification center, a text bubble will show the message you pushed.
[*]You can send system resourse usage data to Live2DViewerEX, which will prepare a widget UI to show the data.
[*]You can send weather data to Live2DViewerEX, and control rain effect or sonw effect to fit current weather.
[*]You can write your background slideshow software and set background file with ExAPI.
[*]You can use Google Voice, Siri and such in your software to recognise voice, then translate the voice to text or choices and send to Live2DViewerEX to show text and choices.
[*]...
[/list]

[h1][b]How To Start[/b][/h1]

Please refer to https://github.com/pavostudio/ExAPI/wiki

notes.title: Something About System Resource Usage & Some Tips
notes.notes:
[h1]System resource usage for Live2DViewerEX includes the following parts[/h1]

[h1]CPU[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The number of models[/b]
More models to be loaded, higher CPU usage.

[*][b]Optimization of models[/b]
It's relevant to the model creator. Sometimes an optimized model can reduce
 50% or more CPU usage.

[*][b]Play video background (Software Decoding)[/b]
If your PC does not support Hardware Decoding or only support DirectX 9, media player must use CPU to decode videos, which will cause an extremely high CPU usage. So it's not recommended to use video background on such devices.

[*][b]Frame rate[/b]
The default frame rate of the software is 60FPS, it's recommended to set to
 30FPS (or less) if you're not so care about the smoothness of model motions, this may reduce about 50% CPU usage.
[/list]


[h1]GPU[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The number of filters[/b]

[*][b]The number of effects[/b]

[*][b]Play video background (Hardware Decoding)[/b]
Media player will use GPU to decode videos instead of CPU. A compressed
 video will reduce GPU usage obviously.
[/list]

[h1]RAM（内存）[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The number of models[/b]

[*][b]Texture size and quantity of models[/b]
Texture size is the main reason that cause a high RAM usage, model creators should reduce size and quantity to prevent it.

[*][b]Size of background resources[/b]
Image and video may cause an extremely RAM usage, which is not avoidable. Sometimes a large image or video may not increase the quality of
 display but eat a lot of RAM, trying to compress it can reduce the usage of RAM.

[*][b]Switch backgrounds and models frequently[/b]
This may cause RAM increases in a short time. To solve this I need more time and work. If you want to free RAM immediately, try to restart the software, or use 3rd-part software to free up it.
[/list]

[h1]ROM[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]The number of subscribed Workshop items[/b]
It's recommended to unsubscribe some items you don't need and delete local files.
[/list]

[h1]Suggestion[/h1]

[b]Wallpaper Mode: [/b]1-2 models + image background + 0-1 filter + 0-1 effect is suitable for most people, with an acceptably resource usage.
[b]Desktop Mode: [/b]since background, filter and effect are not enabled, resource usage is lowest.

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 Introduction: New App Name, New Desktop Mode, New Price
notes.notes:
Greetings

With the release of version 1.2.0, I made some important changes

[h1][b] New Mode: Desktop Mode (Desktop Mascot)[/b] [/h1] 

Display the models on your desktop!
Mouse event supported!
Topmost supported!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29049399/1a11fabacef881aaff694097beeb2b63c832f178.png[/img]


[b]How To Use[/b]
[list]
[*] How to switch: Right-click trayicon -> Launch Mode -> Desktop. [b][u]If you got a black background, please choose 'Desktop (Compat Mode)'[/u][/b]

[*] Desktop Mode does not support Background, Effects and Filters, you will not see these tabs in Main Menu

[*] Desktop Mode does not support Workshop Screenshot

[*] [u]You can not use Desktop Mode and Wallpaper Mode at the same time currently, it will be available in future update[/u]

[*] Desktop Mode supports 'Topmost' and 'No Topmost', you can change it in options of trayicon.

[*] When Desktop Mode enabled, you will see two options in Setting panel of Main Menu, you can adjust them according to the actual situations: 

[list]
[*] Key Color: Application will filter this color to make a transparent background
[*] Color Margin: Filter threshold, a large value means more similar color will be filtered, a small value will let the model has a clear border
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29049399/61289983c35aac2f7703b1d1b85489bb65d6d8ad.png[/img]
[/list]


[h1] [b]New App Name: Live2DViewerEX [/b][/h1]

Since Live2D Wallpaper is not suitable for the new version of application, I decide to change the name to Live2DViewerEX, the same name with an Android APP I made before. 


[h1][b] New Price [/b][/h1]

With the great new feature, I decide to change the price from $3.99 to $4.99



Thank you for your support

[b]Pavo Studio[/b]

notes.notes:
[h1]Start Failed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Check if .Net Framework 4.5 or higher has been installed successfully
[*] Close any anti-virus software, and add the application folder to whitelist
[*] Restart computer
[/list]


[h1]I want to use with Wallpaper Engine[/h1]
Please use Desktop Mode: Right-click trayicon -> Launch Mode -> Desktop


[h1]I got a black background in Desktop Mode[/h1]
Please use Desktop Compat Mode: Right-click trayicon -> Launch Mode -> Desktop (Compat Mode)


[h1]Models show strangely in Desktop Mode[/h1]
Open Main Menu -> Setting -> Desktop, try to adjust Key Color and Color Margin


[h1]How to launch the application at startup[/h1]
Right-click trayicon -> Options -> Launch At Startup
